title: CREATE-007: WIA scanner acquisition reachable from the CLI
acceptance: pdfxi create scan --device acquires pages from an attached WIA scanner through the bundled sidecar and assembles a verified PDF; the synthetic sidecar tests cover the plumbing and the no-scanner error; real hardware evidence is recorded; CREATE-007 becomes verified on the cli host.
notes: ADR 0009 row 10. A real WIA scanner was present on this host, so the device-dependent end-to-end step is recorded with real hardware instead of a blocker.
